text:
harper: Quick follow-up from the Crimson (dedicated/private) postmortem. Root cause: maintenance peering change -> transient BGP flap -> customer on-prem NAT failover -> asymmetric return path exposed an isolation edge-case. Need concrete owners, due dates, and a short validation drill with the customer's SREs. Prefer confirmations by EOD.

lee: I'll take the peering-healthcheck + CI gate. Plan: add pre-deploy BGP neighbor sanity check + a daily synthetic that verifies return next-hop symmetry for a sample keyspace. Due: 2024-10-03.

anya: I'll coordinate the on-prem NAT failover drill with Crimson SRE and capture pcaps/tcptrace. Proposed drill: 2024-10-06 09:00 PT. Need staging host.

mike: I'll own the isolation-bug backport and a feature-flagged canary rollout. PR ETA: 2024-09-30. Rollout plan: 24h canary on a small Dedicated pool, monitor peer flaps, tail-latency, and error-rate.

harper: Staging endpoint: crimson-stg-peers.int.redwood:11778. Please upload captures to /artifacts/crimson/pcaps and tag with customer:crimson.

lee: BGP check snippet for infra libs:
```
# bgp-neighbor-sanity.sh
vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors" | egrep "Neighbor|State|Last update" || exit 1
```

ops-bot: Alert created: /alerts/peer-flap-rate-crimson (threshold=3/min). Linked runbook: /runbooks/peering-isolation.

harper: Consolidated action items (confirm or reassign):
- lee: peering healthcheck + CI gate + symmetric-path synthetic (owner:lee) / due: 2024-10-03
- anya: on-prem NAT failover drill + pcaps (owner:anya) / due: 2024-10-06
- mike: bug backport + feature-flagged rollout + canary checklist (owner:mike) / due: 2024-10-01
- ops-bot: provision alert + annotate runbook (owner:ops-bot) / due: 2024-09-28

harper: We'll tag this pattern in the recurring tracker as "asym-return-peering" and watch for repeats across Dedicated/Private customers. If owners change, post updates here so I can keep the remediation tracker accurate.
